description: Upgrade a Commander precon using preconworkshop. Input a full quantity-prefixed Commander decklist including the commander, or a public HTTPS Moxfield/Archidekt deck URL. URL imports exclude sideboards and Moxfield companions; provider access can fail, in which case request a plain-text export. replaceCard optionally restricts the review to one specific non-protected card. Budget is USD. Returns proposed cuts/additions, role counts, warnings, estimated cost, individual card links and a TCGplayer cartUrl for recommended cards not marked owned. Owned is a quantity-prefixed list of up to 150 card entries with up to 100 copies per named card; locked/excluded are newline-separated card names. Nothing is purchased or saved publicly. Show all warnings and let the player choose swaps. Bracket analysis is guidance, not certification.

deck.description: Full quantity-prefixed decklist, or a public HTTPS Moxfield/Archidekt deck URL without query parameters.

owned.description: Quantity-prefixed owned cards, up to 150 card entries and 16000 characters. Split larger collections before analysis.
